---
title: "RU Tree Stress Test（RU 树压力测试）"
---

Use this appendix to test whether the tree can handle real pressure. A good tree should place common concepts, mixed problems, and ambiguous cases without collapsing into vague language.

## Test 1: Theme Recognition

Place each item under a primary Theme:

| Item | Primary Theme |
|---|---|
| sleep debt | |
| cognitive bias | |
| definition | |
| milestone | |
| trust repair | |
| labor market | |
| data pipeline | |
| sunk cost | |

Check yourself:

- sleep debt → Body
- cognitive bias → Mind
- definition → Language
- milestone → Work
- trust repair → Relationship
- labor market → Society
- data pipeline → Technology
- sunk cost → Value

## Test 2: Misplacement Detection

For each sentence, name the likely misplacement.

1. "I am lazy because I cannot focus after sleeping four hours."
2. "The AI gave a fluent answer, so it must be true."
3. "They apologized, so trust should be restored."
4. "This job pays less, so I am worth less."
5. "Everyone agrees, so the claim is evidence-based."

Possible answers:

1. Body signal misplaced as character flaw.
2. Language fluency misplaced as evidence.
3. Apology misplaced as completed trust repair.
4. Market price misplaced as human value.
5. Social proof misplaced as evidence.

## Test 3: Causal Chain

Choose one messy problem and write:

```text
Because ___,
I experience ___,
so I interpret it as ___,
then I do ___,
which produces ___.
```

Then place each part.

Example:

```text
Because my project has no clear next action,
I experience friction,
so I interpret it as lack of discipline,
then I avoid the project,
which produces more shame.
```

Placement:

- Work → Single Action Task.
- Mind → Emotional Regulation.
- Value → Standard / Meaning.

## Test 4: Associated Positions

Give three associated positions for each concept.

| Concept | Primary Position | Associated Positions |
|---|---|---|
| prompt | Language → Instruction | |
| burnout | Body → Stress / Energy | |
| boundary | Relationship → Boundary | |
| creator economy | Society → Platform Ecology | |
| language model | Technology → AI Model | |

This test checks whether the tree can connect without losing primary position.

## Test 5: Use Sentence

Write one usable sentence for each concept:

- attention residue
- emotional boundary
- acceptance criteria
- platform rule
- compound return

Good use sentences do not merely define the concept. They change judgment or action.

Example:

> Acceptance criteria tell me when work is complete; effort alone is not a completion standard.

## Passing Standard

The tree passes the stress test when you can:

- identify a primary Theme quickly;
- name at least one Group or Container;
- detect a common misplacement;
- write one sentence that changes action or judgment;
- add associated positions without making the concept vague.

If the tree fails, do not add more concepts first. Strengthen the placement language.
